data.title: Bermy Bots To Compete In Atlanta Robotics - Bernews
data.description: Bermuda’s National Robotics Team, the Bermy Bots, has travelled to Atlanta, Georgia, to compete in the 2026/27 FIRST Tech Challenge season. A spokesperson said, “And they’re off!
